articles.summary: Cardiol Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ: CRDL) (TSX: CRDL) is pleased to announce that it will participate in a Fireside Chat at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York, NY, on September 14, 2026, at 10:30 a.m. EDT.
articles.title: Cardiol Therapeutics to Participate in a Fireside Chat at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference
